newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lihir Gold project nears completion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lihir Gold project nears completion.

text.p: Engineering for Lihir Gold Ltd's New Guinea gold project was 99 percent complete at the end of the December quarter, while total construction was 67 percent complete, the company said in its quarterly report.
Construction of process plant facilities was 60 percent complete, while construction of the oxide ore related facilities was 72 percent complete, it said.
The company started drawdown under its main US$300 million finance facility, drawing the first tranche of US$60 million in mid-November 1996, it said.
The first two 975 cubic metre waste rock barges the MV Luise and MV Kinami were completed in Singapore and arrived at Lihir Island on January 4, it said.
No systematic exploration activity other than mapping and sampling was undertaken in the quarter, the company said.
No production took place during the quarter.
Project expenditure to December 31 totalled US$509.3 million. Commitments on contracts and purchase orders at December 31 totalled $679.5 million, it said.
